denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

measurements.reason_detail: production parses through java-grobid-http/0.9.1/processFulltextDocument at the structural profile; the native PDF-to-TEI route is not connected to a runner, so no java-free product measurement exists
no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

runs.load: run alongside concurrent work; not a controlled serial run
serial re-run without concurrent cargo or python load

hypothesis.statement: the first failure may have been an environment-sensitive interaction in the da-parse test binary rather than a source regression; the bind-then-drop shape of http_backend_surfaces_transport_outage_as_unavailable is one candidate
hypothesis.evidence_from_the_failed_run: none: the gate printed only the last five stderr lines and did not record the failing test or its output
hypothesis.disconfirming_evidence: an isolated re-run of the same step and of backend_contract reported zero failures
cannot_conclude: no claim that a flake was eliminated
no claim that no regression occurred

diagnostics_change.what: the architecture gate now persists the full stdout and stderr of every failing step and extracts the libtest failing-test names, so the next failure identifies itself

historical_guard_pins.note: sha256 of the M513 carriers this slice must not touch. Recomputed by scripts/tests/test_absorption_progress_baseline.py; a changed byte here is a finding, never a silent re-pin. Boundary: a writer able to rewrite both this ledger and the carriers can satisfy it.

without_path_identity.note: M513/S03 UAT-4 pins agree with every surface. Preserved as an identity; never re-run and republished as fresh evidence.
